description: Corner-relief v1 flat-pattern golden (docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.4): the SAME authored corner tray as corner-tray-perp-unfold (rectangular base flange 40 x 30 mm + two edge flanges on PERPENDICULAR, corner-sharing edges), now with an EXPLICIT rectangular corner relief at the two bends' shared corner. The relief cuts a LOCAL corner notch: a size x size square of base material at the corner, PLUS a size-wide notch of developed depth (BA + size) into each flange's corner root (through the bend arc and size up the folded wall). The folded wall stays FULL width above the notch, so the developed blank folds back to the 3D relieved body (fold-back cross-consistency, §4.4.4): the relieved body's bend cylindrical-face width equals the flat bend_widths_mm, and removed 3D volume equals removed flat area x thickness up to the bend's neutral-vs-mean-radius term. Both halves model the SAME physical removal, driven by the SAME CornerRelief spec.

relief.bends: both edge flanges of the tray (the two bends whose intersection is the shared base corner); the test builds the CornerRelief from the two evaluated CylindricalFaceSignatures (§5).

tangent_line_convention: Same as corner-tray-perp-unfold: each leg is measured to its bend TANGENT LINE (§9 #1); the base develops to its 40 x 30 flat top face, edge flange B (off x=40, axis +Y) develops leg 20 mm, edge flange A (off y=30, axis +X) develops leg 25 mm; two bend allowances REPLACE the two sharp-corner setbacks. Corner relief then cuts a LOCAL notch at the shared-corner end of each flange (width size_mm, developed depth BA + size_mm) and removes the base's size_mm x size_mm corner square.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED analytic values. Base 40 (X) x 30 (Y) mm; flange off x=40 develops leg 20 mm over width 30 (along +Y axis); flange off y=30 develops leg 25 mm over width 40 (along +X axis); gauge t = 2 mm, inner radius r = 3 mm, both 90 deg, K = 0.44. Relief size s = relief_ratio * t = 1.5 * 2.0 = 3.0 mm (>= bend_radius 3.0, the §4.4.3 floor so the notch clears the arc).
Bend allowance (§1), both bends: BA = (pi/2)*(3 + 0.44*2) = 6.094689747964199 mm.

Relieved developed area (§9 #2 with removed material subtracted): flat_area = UNRELIEVED_area - removed, where UNRELIEVED_area = 3226.628282357494 (corner-tray-perp-unfold) and removed = base corner square (s*s = 9) + flange-B corner notch (s * (BA + s) = 3 * 9.094689747964199 = 27.284069243892597) + flange-A corner notch (same s * (BA + s) = 27.284069243892597) = 63.5681384877852. The notch is LOCAL (developed depth BA + s = 9.09 mm), NOT a full-length narrowing of the whole flange, so both flanges share the SAME notch removal regardless of their differing leg lengths (20 vs 25). flat_area = 3226.628282357494 - 63.5681384877852 = 3163.0601438697086 mm^2. The reentrant notch is a genuine CUT in the single closed outline, not a separate hole.

Envelope is UNCHANGED by relief (the notch is a LOCAL bite at the concave inner corner; the flange far ends keep full extent AND full width): flat_length (frame-X extent) = 61.094689747964196 mm; bend_width (frame-Y extent) = 66.0946897479642 mm -- identical to the unrelieved tray.

Bend widths are the NOTCHED spans (the fold line is shortened by s at the corner end): flange off x=40 span 30 -> 27, flange off y=30 span 40 -> 37, so bend_widths_mm = [27.0, 37.0]. Each fold line spans its flange's notched width; flat_end - flat_start == BA.

Outline: ONE closed loop with a reentrant (L-shaped) corner notch reaching into BOTH arms. Body edges: 10 (the local corner notch splits each arm into a notched-near and a full-width-far region around the reentrant corner). Bend edges: 2 (one fold line per bend). The enclosed shoelace area of the body loop equals flat_area exactly (independent witness that the layout tiles the blank).

3D relieved body (apply_corner_relief): one slot per flange, each s wide along its bend axis, cutting from the base corner THROUGH the full bend arc and s up the folded wall (the folded image of the flat notch). It removes 129.3982236861566 mm^3 (relieved volume 6350.247719318986 vs base 6479.645943005143) and leaves ONE connected shell. FOLD-BACK CROSS-CONSISTENCY (§4.4.4): removed_volume == removed_area * t + bias, where removed_area * t = 63.5681384877852 * 2 = 127.1362769755704 (developed / neutral-axis material) and bias = bend_count * s * angle * t^2 * (0.5 - K) = 2 * 3 * (pi/2) * 4 * 0.06 = 2.2619467105846514 (the bend's neutral-vs-mean-radius volume term), summing to 129.39822368615503 -- matching the measured removed volume to ~1e-11. AND the relieved body's inner bend cylindrical-face widths are [27.0, 37.0] == bend_widths_mm. Both halves model the SAME removal.

content_hash is the sha256 of the relieved FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- a DETERMINISM PIN reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4). A change without a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0).
tolerance_rationale: Same basis as corner-tray-perp-unfold (build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat-pattern residuals vs hand-derived are ~1e-12 (area) / ~5e-12 (extents) / ~1e-11 (BA, from arc-fit inner-radius FP noise ~1e-14). Ceiling 1e-9 gives 2-3 orders of headroom while staying tighter than the kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). Volume tolerance 1e-6 absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by width; the fold-back removed_volume == removed_area*t + bias identity holds to ~1e-11.
